hero.label: Oversight
hero.title: Continuous Monitoring & Accountability
hero.desc: Active oversight mechanisms that protect investors and ensure issuers deliver on their commitments.

features.title: Issuer Monitoring
features.text: Ongoing monitoring of issuer financial health, milestone delivery, and covenant compliance throughout the security lifecycle.

features.title: Reporting Requirements
features.text: Mandatory quarterly reporting from issuers. Financial statements, operational updates, and material event disclosures per offering memorandum terms.

features.title: Dispute Resolution
features.text: Established procedures for investor complaints and disputes. Escalation paths and arbitration mechanisms built into offering terms.

features.title: Early Warning System
features.text: Automated monitoring of payment schedules, covenant triggers, and issuer communications. Proactive investor alerts.

info_blocks.title: Trust Indicators
info_blocks.intro: Each CrossSecurities offering displays verified trust indicators:
items: Audited: Financial statements verified by independent auditors
PPM: Private placement memorandum filed or delivered
Regulated: Issuer operates in regulated industry or jurisdiction

info_blocks.title: Governance Framework
info_blocks.intro: CrossSecurities offerings include governance provisions protecting investor rights via smart contract enforcement:
items: Transfer agent and paying agent appointments
Trustee oversight on every offering

info_blocks.title: Multi-Party Controls
info_blocks.intro: No single person can make critical changes unilaterally—not the issuer, not the platform, not anyone:
items: Multiple approvers required: Sensitive operations need sign-off from independent keyholders
Recorded decisions: Every approval is logged with an immutable audit trail
Separation of duties: The people who propose changes aren't the same people who approve them
info_blocks.outro: This isn't bureaucracy for its own sake. It's protection against insider threats, compromised accounts, and honest mistakes.
